thread.title: Calendar of Events for Thursday

author: Matt Harvey
title: Calendar of Events for Thursday
text:
Submit items for Calendar of Events at www.theet.com, email to news@wvnews.com, fax to 304-624-4188 or mail to The Exponent Telegram, P.O. Box 2000, Clarksburg, W.Va. 26302. Items should be brief and must include a contact person and phone number. Deadline for submission is noon Monday through Friday. The Exponent Telegram recommends readers confirm events before attending.
Thursday, July 16
American Legion Auxiliary 31 monthly meeting, covered dish dinner at 6 p.m., meeting at 7 p.m., American Legion Post 31, Shinnston.
Saturday, July 18
Anna Jarvis Park show lineup, 6-9 p.m., with Anna Jarvis Stage Band, open mic, special guest Doug Jones. Admission: $6 adults; free for children. Food, drinks, drawings available. 304-265-5549.
Monday, July 20
VFW House Committee meeting, 6 p.m. at the post. Regular meeting 7 p.m.
Tuesday, July 21
Clarksburg Retired Postal Employees meeting, 9 a.m., Bridgeport IHOP. 304-624-4262.
Celebrate Recovery at Clarksburg Baptist Church. Tuesdays at 6:30 p.m. Doors open at 6:15 p.m. Bonita Totten, 304-672-1657; Lou Ortenzio, 304-677-8880, louortenzio@gmail.com.
Thursday, July 23
Greater Harrison County PSD regular board meeting, 9 a.m., West Milford Community Building, N. Liberty St., West Milford.
Friday, July 24
Washington Irving High School Class of 1958 Breakfast, 11 a.m., FOP Elite Room, Nutter Fort.
Clarksburg Lions Club meeting, noon, Brickside Bar & Grille, 101 Lodgeville Road, Bridgeport. Speaker: Clarksburg Mayor Wayne Worth. Details: President Patty Flanigan, 304-669-6449; Al Cox, 304-216-5251.
Saturday, July 25
Fort New Salem’s Myths of the Mountains, lamplight guided night tours with Appalachian tales. Admission: $8 (10 and under free). Tour length is about an hour. Tours start every 10 minutes, beginning at 8 p.m. Final tour at 9:30 p.m. Details: 304-695-2220.
Monday, July 27
Knights of Columbus Council 872 regular business meeting, 7 p.m., Council Hall, 334 E. Pike St., Clarksburg.
Millennium Quilt Guild meeting, 6:30 p.m., Benedum Civic Center. For details, call 304-203-3805.
Tuesday, July 28
Celebrate Recovery at Clarksburg Baptist Church. Tuesdays at 6:30 p.m. Doors open at 6:15 p.m. Bonita Totten, 304-672-1657; Lou Ortenzio, 304-677-8880, louortenzio@gmail.com.
Friday, July 31
David Schwind Memorial Golf Tournament benefiting WV Caring Hospice & Palliative Care, 10 a.m., Clarksburg Country Club, 199 Club Drive, Clarksburg. Registration: https://www.wvcaring.org/wv-caring-events/ For more information, contact Mike Bell at mbell@wvcaring.org or 727-798-4401.
Through July 31
Art Gallery at James & Law, 8 a.m.-5 p.m. Monday-Friday. Featured artists for July: Debi W. Eastep, watercolor, photography and mixed media; Linda Turner, watercolor; Peter Seguin, mixed media and acrylics; Amber Penland, collage, mixed media & acrylics.
Saturday, Aug. 1
Roosevelt-Wilson Class of 1965 monthly brunch, 11 a.m., FOP Restaurant, Nutter Fort. Alumni, family and friends welcome. 304-745-5444
Saturday, Aug. 8
Authentic Unlimited, Sue Morris Sports Complex Live Stage, 1294 U.S. 33, Glenville. Gates open at 5 p.m. Opening act Kenny Smith and the Putnam Boys at 7 p.m. Authentic Unlimited at 8 p.m. Donations for the concert are expected and collected at the gate. A dinner will be available by donation.
Harrison County Association of Retired School Employees August picnic, 4 p.m., Clarksburg Park, Nutter Fort, at the Maple Shelter. Hot dogs provided. Recent retirees invited. Bring a covered dish. Program: Installation of officers.
Thursday, Aug. 13
Roosevelt-Wilson Class of 1957 monthly brunch, 11 a.m., FOP Restaurant, Nutter Fort. Alumni, family and friends welcome. 304-566-7397
Tuesday, Aug. 18
Clarksburg Retired Postal Employees meeting, 9 a.m., IHOP, Bridgeport. 304-624-4262
